sources.title: GitHub - MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-27B-16gb-NVIDIA-GPUs-one-click-install ...
sources.snippet: A serving kit for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B in turboderp 's EXL3 quants, on one consumer NVIDIA card. It picks a quant that fits the card it finds, installs its own Python environment, downloads the weights, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and opens a chat UI.
